rows.quote: In this work, we performed a GWAS of senile cataract in the All of Us (AoU) research program cohort, and then conducted ancestry-stratified GWAS meta-analyses of cataract in European and East Asian participants to advance understanding of its genetic architecture.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names a GWAS performed in the All of Us research program cohort as the outcome data; no dictionary outcome row for it.

rows.quote: Strong evidence of colocalisation was observed for MTMR3 and NT5DC2 (PP.H4 = 0.85 and 0.96, respectively) (Fig. 3, Supplementary Table S10).Fig. 3Overview of cis-eQTL- and cis-pQTL- based MR and colocalisation analyses for cataract in European and East Asian ancestry. ∗Colocalisation for the CKB pQTL analysis was not performed because regional pQTL summary statistics were unavailable. eQTLGen, eQTLGen Consortium whole-blood meta-analysis; JCTF, Japan COVID-19 Task Force; UKB-PPP, UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project; CKB, China Kadoorie Biobank; pQTL, protein quantitative trait loci; eQTL, expression quantitative trait loci.
rows.coder_note: Sentence refers to the CKB pQTL analysis and expands CKB as China Kadoorie Biobank; no dictionary pQTL row for it.
UKB-PPP named with a sample size that equals no UKB-PPP row size and a citation shared by several rows.

rows.quote: For plasma protein instruments in European ancestry, two large pQTL datasets were used: the deCODE proteomics study (n = 35,559) and the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP, n = 46,281).21,22 Protein levels were measured using the SomaScan platform in deCODE and the Olink platform in UKB-PPP, as described in the original publications.
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E. Sulem P. Atlason B.A. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat Genet 53 12 2021 1712 1721 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the deCODE proteomics study (n = 35,559, SomaScan) to citation 21, the first of its two ordered citations; that entry DOI is the Ferkingstad 2021 row source only.
